_notes: Written by the Sound Lab (sound-lab.html). Engine names and planned rpm are unchecked until ticked there.

build:inline.reference: Starts as the sound of every inline aircraft engine. Cylinders, rpm and propeller still come from each plane, so the synth differs between them.

build:radial.reference: Starts as the sound of every radial aircraft engine. Clips worth finding first: R-1820 (Brewster, B-17) and ASh-82 (La-5FN, Pe-8).

build:tankPetrol.reference: Panzer IV, Churchill, BT-42 and later the Tiger. All tank builds start with the same synth as the generic tank.

build:tankDiesel.reference: T-34, Chi-Ha and later the KV-1S.

build:tankRadial.reference: M4A1 Sherman: an aero radial in a tank.

engine:db605a.reference: Clips can be shared with the other DB 605, and a DB 601 is close enough to borrow them.

engine:db605b.reference: Clips can be shared with the other DB 605, and a DB 601 is close enough to borrow them.

engine:db601e.reference: Close enough to the DB 605 to borrow its clips.

engine:merlin61.reference: One set of Merlin clips covers the Spitfire, Mosquito, Hurricane and Lancaster.
